node.title: Exact spend calibration for the rate-half type-2 FR route
node.statement: At the worst NEWCAP support size a=7m-1, the outside-incidence ledger gives T<=2+floor((9m+1)m/p) when every type-2 slope spends at least p roots outside W. The exact least spend closing T<=4m is floor((9m+1)m/(4m-1))+1, equal to 9m/4+1 when 4 divides m. For a clean locator this is |S intersect W|<=7m/4-2. The prior p=2m+2 proposal is insufficient for m>=8 and leaves an asymptotic 9/8 residual. This calibrates the route and does not prove the required spend.
